models.purpose: Place destination chargers and superchargers on two layers.
models.summary: The inner layer serves people who stay in one county. Six user groups by daily mileage each need a load L, and the destination count DTL is the maximum of the summed load over the day. Cities get a share proportional to traffic density. People who forget to charge, a share a, need superchargers scaled by a damage factor rd, so STL = DTL times a times rd. The outer layer serves long-distance travelers. A city is a hub by betweenness, Bi = sum of njl(i) over njl, weighted by the population and road length it connects. Superchargers sit every 130 miles on the shortest path. With US population 323.1 million, 0.766 vehicles per person and 43.4 miles a day, DTL is 8.08 million and superchargers are 2.16 million, 1.62 long-distance and 0.54 short-distance. Ireland gets 78 thousand and 20.8 thousand.

variables.definition: distance at which a traveler charges, 130 miles

objectives: Place destination chargers and superchargers on two layers.
constraints: a station holds exactly one charger

parameter_estimation.method: US inputs from cited statistics; a = 0.3 and rd = 0.25 for Ireland

assumptions: only personal passenger vehicles are counted

identifiability_feasibility.analysis: 1.62 plus 0.54 million gives the stated 2.16 million superchargers

strengths: travelers are split before any station is placed
limitations: the summary says the switch takes 108 years for the constructed network and 36 for the growing one; the body text reverses the two
missing_details: the six mileage groups are named but their boundaries are not printed

models.summary: Satisfaction D mixes the long-trip share with the station counts already built, each divided by the final count times permeability. The daily contact rate is lambda = (D - X) P / D, positive only above a threshold X. The electric share then grows as di/dt = lambda i (1 - i). With w = 0.7, a = 0.3 and PT = 0.002 the threshold is 1.85. The current network reaches full electrification in 108 years and the growing network in 36, on the figure; the prose swaps them. For Ireland the fastest plan builds at twice the present scale and mixes city and rural at 3 to 2, matching an urbanization of 63.2 percent. Below 30 percent permeability build destination stations, between 30 and 50 build city superchargers, above 50 build road superchargers.

models.purpose: Find which stage the contact rate moves.
models.summary: Starting from i(0) = 0.01, the share is integrated at contact rates 0.27, 0.3 and 0.33. Early and late the three curves stay close; at year 15 they stand at about 0.4, 0.5 and 0.6. The middle stage is where a gain in satisfaction speeds the switch.

variables.definition: spread of the three curves at year 15

governing_equations.source_expression: i(15) differs by about 0.2 across the three rates
governing_equations.purpose: mid-stage spread under a contact-rate sweep

objectives: Find which stage the contact rate moves.
constraints: the contact rate is held constant within a run
assumptions: satisfaction can be raised by policy
